Who would have thought Shangguan would meet Liu Si'an.
A day as husband and wife brings the wish to grow old together; a hundred days of affection forge an unbreakable bond.
Shangguan and Anniang once dreamed of witnessing Chang'an's splendor, singing under the moon.
Their union drew envy, their love brought joy to heaven and earth.
Yet time sowed discord, fate proved unkind, and hardships left grievances unresolved.
Gentle as willow, kind and meek, Anniang could neither serve elders nor manage the household.
Now, setting her free brings relief. May she find a better home.
May she drink beneath blossoms, admire the moon, and be surrounded by grandchildren. Let kin rejoice, and Shangguan rest without regret.
As proof, in Wannian County, Chang'an,
Shangguan Ze solemnly declares.
